issues.issue: Should the December 2020 affidavit be admitted, and should an oral hearing be held?
issues.applicant_position: Affidavit is new evidence; hearsay in it raises a serious credibility issue, so an oral hearing is needed.
issues.result_text: Affidavit admitted as new evidence; oral hearing refused as no serious credibility issue arises.

issues.issue: Would the appellant face serious persecution or s. 97 risk from cartel members in Merida or Campeche?
issues.applicant_position: RPD ignored evidence of targeting by cartel members; threats and a note on his sister's body show pursuit.
issues.result_text: Cartels not shown to be motivated to locate him in the IFA; first prong of the IFA test met.

issues.issue: Would the appellant face risk from his former Canadian supervisor if returned to Mexico?
issues.applicant_position: Former supervisor deceived and threatened him; his continued interest justifies the claim.
issues.respondent_position: Counsel acknowledged uncertainty whether the supervisor poses a risk in Mexico.
issues.result_text: No evidence the supervisor can locate or harm the appellant in Mexico.

issues.issue: Is relocation to Merida or Campeche objectively unreasonable (second prong of the IFA test)?
issues.applicant_position: Campeche is dangerous and far from home; crime in Merida and Campeche shows the IFA is not safe.
issues.result_text: Relocation to Campeche or Merida is not objectively unreasonable; an IFA need not be crime-free.
